file.description: Path to a Markdown file with front matter

head.description: Head branch, or owner:branch for a branch of a fork (default: the current branch)

no_issue_ref.description: Skip the automatic related-Issue setup (extraction from the branch name, adding it to the body, and the validation check)

screenshot.description: Reason to omit an image from Summary (with `message`)

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

number.description: Number of the created PR (omitted when the response has none)

head.description: Head branch of the PR, owner:branch for a branch of a fork

inReview.description: Issue number whose status was set to In Review (omitted when not set)

stack.description: Stack of the PR (omitted when the PR is not stacked)

lower.description: PR number of the lower stage the new PR is stacked on

registered.description: Whether the new PR was registered to the stack

issue.description: Issue as shown in the moved line (#N, or owner/repo#N outside the home repository)

from.description: Column before the move (omitted when only the Status changed)

to.description: Column after the move (omitted when only the Status changed)

label.description: Status value set (omitted when the Status did not change)

moves.description: Issues waiting for this PR whose column or Status was written

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
